partition: original explicit manifest only; no scenario reassignment
novelty: Isolation Forest held-out-family ranking. C2 already excluded from all training/preprocessing. DDoS supplementary preprocessor excludes all ddos training rows, then benign-only IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, random_state=42). No additional supervised novelty model. Other families lack support in fixed TEST and are not evaluated.
thresholds: 1% and 5% upper validation-benign score quantiles, method=higher; report achieved FPR and tie effects; exploratory
robustness: First 10000 TEST rows in recorded adapter order, seed42. Existing five perturbations; preserve original NaNs so unavailable columns are never fabricated. Report sample support and limited prefix scope.
one_way: Full TEST, established reverse-direction/ratio zeroing on available values only; preserve original NaNs. Simulated telemetry loss, not physical reconstruction.
serialization: Estimator parameter missing=NaN in XGBoost is encoded as JSON null by run.py; actual resolved value is numpy.nan. Other null parameters represent estimator defaults unless noted. No change to estimator behavior.
